description:
The adopter-facing CLI contract for machine output gets one canonical statement in `docs/reference/cli-commands.md` that matches the refactored behaviour, and other pages cite it.

## Background

`docs/reference/cli-commands.md` §"CLI JSON contracts" states the success payload, the failure envelope and the clap-diagnostic exemption, but not the list envelope, which appears only in `README.md` and `docs/concepts/design-philosophy.md` and per command. The page mentions `[--json]` per command although `--json` is now one global flag. Its wrong-verb section says the hint arrives in `error.message` under `--json`. The CLI now behaves as follows. List payloads are `{"count": N, "<collection>": [...]}` plus command-specific fields. Once clap has accepted the arguments, a failing `--json` invocation writes exactly one envelope to stdout and nothing to stderr; successful JSON responses carry warnings in a top-level `warnings` array, while human-mode warnings go to stderr; human-mode failures print one `Error:` line. A command whose findings make it exit non-zero (`validate`, `gate status-all`, `gate evaluate-many`, `doc check-links`, `invariant check`) renders the failure envelope with its report in `error.details`, and the exit code is that envelope's code. A wrong verb prints its hint and clap's diagnostic to stderr and exits 2, with or without `--json`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The "CLI JSON contracts" section states the list envelope, the global `--json` option, the stream rule for failures after a successful parse (one envelope on stdout, nothing on stderr, successful JSON warnings in a top-level `warnings` array and human-mode warnings on stderr), the findings envelope, and the parser-level wrong-verb hint, each once.
- [hard] REQ-02: Per-command entries carry no `[--json]` option mention, and `README.md` and `docs/concepts/design-philosophy.md` cite the reference section for the list envelope instead of restating it.
- [hard] REQ-03: No statement in `docs/` contradicts the contract, including the hint-in-envelope and errors-always-on-stderr wording.
- [hard] REQ-04: The documentation link and citation checks pass.

## Notes

`docs/reference/error-codes.md` and `exit-codes.md` are generated and are cited, not edited. Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md`.

## Decisions

- D-01: Correct the stream wording to the existing epic D-04 and 9529b9ac contract: successful JSON carries warnings in its top-level `warnings` array; human-mode warnings go to stderr. Steward approved this reconciliation on 2026-11-04; no output-policy or gate change.


- D-02: Steward approved one additional bounded prose repair round on 2026-11-05: correct the three inconsistent collection examples and the graph summary, remove the universal envelope-exit claim from the canonical exit-reference generator in `crates/jit/src/schema.rs`, and regenerate `docs/reference/exit-codes.md` with the existing script. This extends the documentation footprint to that generator string and its derived page; it changes no runtime behavior, status mapping, checker, gate or criterion. Generated references remain projections and are never hand-edited.
title: State the CLI output contract once in the command reference
